highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 ships on Skia m151 with a broad managed-layer performance sprint and WebAssembly .NET 11 support.
highlights_body: Key wins include allocation-free HarfBuzz UTF-8 encoding and Tag parsing, zero-copy Span reads for SKShaper, SKColor math ported to managed code, and Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11 WASM. A native resource leak in SKImage is also fixed.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine is now built from the m151 milestone, and four rounds of upstream chrome/m151 stability fixes have been merged.
Removed a duplicate SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM define from the Skia submodule so Emscripten builds no longer report macro redefinition noise.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing overloads and performance
bullets.detail: SKColor.Parse now accepts ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads and internal hex parsing was optimized, reducing allocations in text-heavy rendering loops.
The unnecessary unsafe modifier was dropped from GRContextOptions.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed
bullets.detail: A native resource leak in the SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) overload is corrected, preventing memory growth in image-heavy workloads.

bullets.lead: Performance: SKColor/SKColorF conversion ported to managed math
bullets.detail: The SKColor ↔ SKColorF conversion and SKPMColor single-value premultiply/unpremultiply are now computed in managed integer arithmetic, removing P/Invoke round-trips from common hot paths.

bullets.lead: Performance: HarfBuzz allocation-free text encoding and tag parsing
bullets.detail: Buffer.AddUtf8(string) now encodes into a pooled buffer instead of allocating a new byte array, and both HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse eliminate their per-call char[4] allocations.

bullets.lead: Performance: zero-copy spans for SKShaper glyph results
bullets.detail: Glyph result arrays from SKShaper are now read via Span<T>, removing managed array copies from shaping-heavy workloads.
Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries are included for the .NET 11 WASM target, with the new exnref exception-handling ABI. A preview-.NET WASM test job now guards against exception-handling regressions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Fixed the WebAssembly Skia build by removing the redundant SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM define upstream and contributed the Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 WASM

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151 line with the Skia m151 engine update and the WebAssembly Skia build cleanup.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 delivered the managed performance sprint: allocation-free HarfBuzz UTF-8 encoding, per-call char[4] elimination from Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse, zero-copy Span reads for SKShaper, and the SKColor ReadOnlySpan overloads.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: RC 1 landed SKColor/SKColorF and SKPMColor managed math, Emscripten 5.0.6 for .NET 11, the native resource leak fix in SKImage, and the final round of m151 upstream stability fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds allocation-free UTF-8 encoding in Buffer.AddUtf8 and eliminates the per-call char[4] allocation in Tag.Parse, reducing GC pressure in shaping-heavy workloads. Ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.
